scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Is there a kind of person around you who gets whatever they want? Do you think they're just lucky? Actually, they understand human nature.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: People who get what they want have a talent: they can quickly identify who the other person is and communicate in a way that person likes. They know how to give D-types a big picture and vision...

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: ...because D-types are goal-oriented pioneers. They know how to make friends with I-types and praise them...

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: ...because I-types crave recognition. They know how to take it slow with S-types and provide patience and security...

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: ...because S-types need a sense of security. They know to show C-types data and logic because C-types value the correctness of procedures.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: So these people don't have magic; they just understand that those who are unwilling to understand others will spend their lives working for those who understand themselves.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: If you want to be someone who gets what they want, start by understanding human nature. Follow me, and I'll teach you the DISC behavioral patterns.
